items.title: Shawna Clay's 40 years keep fleet data moving
items.description: Shawna Clay marked 40 years of civil service at Point Mugu in September. carriers.title: CNATRA Training Air Wing 1 and 2 Conduct Student Naval Aviator Carrier Qualifications Aboard Nimitz
carriers.description: T-45 C Goshawks, attached to Chief of Naval Air Training (CNATRA) Training Air Wings 1 and 2, conduct flight operations aboard Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN 68) during student naval aviator carrier qualifications in the Atlantic Ocean, Nov. 4, 2026. Nimitz is underway in the U.S. 2nd Fleet area of operations in support of Commander, Naval Air Force Atlantic training and readiness. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Apprentice Hunter Kelley)
